name: Takashina Satoshi
source:
She is [url=https://vndb.org/c69166]Toshio[/url]'s wife.

She lives like a hermit in the "wild zone" with her [url=https://vndb.org/c69166]husband[/url], far from the city. Her [url=https://vndb.org/c69166]husband[/url] and her has made this choice because they have lost their daughter during the disaster.

[spoiler]She is the true mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c14897]Chimari[/url] and was a close friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url]'s parents.[/spoiler]
